channel.title: CAIS AI Safety Newsletter
channel.description: Center for AI Safety weekly newsletter.

item.title: CAIS Newsletter #128: New AISI Network Working Group on Deception
item.description: The AISI Network announced a new working group on deceptive behaviour evaluations across UK / US / Japan / Korea / Singapore institutes.

item.title: CAIS Newsletter #127: Frontier Model Forum publishes joint safety commitments
item.description: FMF members release joint commitments on cybersecurity disclosure and red-team data sharing.

item.title: CAIS Newsletter #126: METR releases benchmarking suite for autonomous task completion
item.description: METR's new evaluation suite measures frontier-model autonomous task completion across 50+ task domains.

item.title: CAIS Newsletter #125: New AI safety institute opens in Brazil
item.description: Brazilian government announces a national AI safety institute under the ANPD; first frontier-model evaluations expected late 2026.
